rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a regular routine or an action done automatically through repetition, but not specifically an addiction.

example.english: I drink a glass of water as soon as I wake up every day; I’ve kept this habit for many years.
example.traditional: 我日日一瞓醒就飲杯水，呢個習慣保持咗好多年。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat6 jat6 jat1 fan3 seng2 zau6 jam2 bui1 seoi2 ni1 go3 zaap6 gwaan3 bou2 ci4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4

rows.note: Use this for an addictive dependence or compulsive craving, especially when talking about giving it up.

example.english: I have a smoking habit, and even trying to quit is hard.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 jin1 jan5 soeng2 gaai3 dou1 hou2 naan4
